editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the NCMA Certified Contracts Manager Exam covering 7 distinct contract management domains across 180 total questions.
editorial.overview: The NCMA Certified Contracts Manager Exam evaluates professional knowledge and operational competencies across leadership, management, guiding principles, pre-award, award, post-award, and learning. Candidates are tested on their ability to navigate complex business relationships, regulatory requirements, and various contract life cycle phases. This official evaluation validates professional capabilities for practitioners operating within the broader discipline of contract management according to established industry standards and guidelines.
editorial.who_should_take: Contract managers, buyers, sellers, and procurement professionals with occupational experience seeking to validate their contract management proficiency and professional skills across the entire contract life cycle.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review the Contract Management Standard and the Contract Management Body of Knowledge to prepare for the assessment. Focus your study sessions on the seven domains, fundamental contract principles, professional standards of conduct, and specific job tasks across pre-award, award, and post-award life cycle phases to ensure complete readiness before taking the exam.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers leadership proficiency, personal character, collaboration strategies, emotional intelligence, and long-term vision required for successful contract managers working within modern organizational environments and complex professional settings.

This domain addresses targeted management skills, commercial business acumen, professional judgment, situational assessment methodologies, and team dynamics necessary for effectively handling diverse operational challenges throughout every stage of the contracting process.

This domain focuses intensely on the fundamental principles of contracting, including offer, acceptance, legal consideration, and the mutual intent to create a binding relationship recognized under applicable laws and standard commercial practices.

This domain involves buyer and seller processes related to developing formal solicitations and preparing competitive offers during the initial pre-award phase of the contract lifecycle in order to establish clear commercial arrangements.

This domain encompasses contract formation processes including price or cost analysis, strategic negotiation planning, systematic source selection, and effective management of disagreements or disputes between contracting parties during the award phase.

This domain covers active contract performance execution, business relationship management, quality assurance, change management protocols, and formal contract closeout procedures to ensure full compliance and successful project delivery during post-award.

This specific domain involves continuous lifelong learning activities designed to advance individual professional competence and enhance overall organizational capability within the dynamic and ever-evolving field of contract management practice.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively across 180 total questions during the 240-minute duration. Read each question carefully and apply your knowledge of contract management principles and regulatory compliance.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official certification examination is comprised of 180 total questions spanning all of the subject domains defined within the Contract Management Standard and related guides.
To achieve a successful result and earn certification, candidates must meet or exceed the official passing score requirement established at exactly 72.2% on the evaluation.
Candidates are granted a total duration of 240 minutes to complete all questions, manage their time effectively, and review their answers before submitting the examination.
This professional certification examination is officially administered, governed, and certified by the National Contract Management Association, which is widely recognized in the industry as NCMA.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official documentation and exam guides sourced directly from NCMA to provide completely factual details on domains and testing requirements.
